pages.text: $(l)Fireclay$()$(br)Fireclay is the first wall of the progression: fireproof bricks for the casting basin, the blast stove and the blast furnace all come from it. Dig it with a $(item)shovel$().

$(li)A fireclay block drops $(item)1 fireclay ball$(), and four balls craft back into a block, so mine the layer generously.$(br2)$(l)The Nether$()$(br)In the Nether, clusters appear between $(item)Y 40 and Y 90$(), also in about one chunk out of 18. Two patterns exist:
$(li)$(item)Sulfur$() with scorchia, blackstone, magma and basalt. This is the $(item)only place sulfur generates$().$(li)$(item)Fireclay$() with scorchia, gravel, magma, soul sand and soul soil.
Sulfur feeds gunpowder, sulfuric acid and rubber later on, so bring back a good stack on your first trip.
